attributes.title: Midwest Veterinary Conference 2027
attributes.summary:
The 2027 Midwest Veterinary Conference, hosted by the Ohio Veterinary Medical Association, takes place live in Columbus, Ohio, on February 18 to 20, 2027, with the Greater Columbus Convention Center listed as the conference venue. A virtual edition follows, with on-demand access from March 3 to August 31, 2027.

The conference site describes three live days, more than 300 sessions across 25+ tracks and up to 18 hours of in-person CE. The virtual pass covers 87 recorded lectures in 14 tracks.

Registration is open. For all three days in person, OVMA members and out-of-state veterinarians pay $300 through January 19, 2027, then $375; Ohio veterinarians who are not members pay $475, then $550; technicians and staff pay $215, then $290. One- and two-day rates are lower, and a hybrid package adds the virtual conference for $125 more ($75 for technicians and staff). The virtual-only pass is $250 for members and out-of-state veterinarians, $425 for Ohio non-members and $175 for technicians and staff. OVMA student members attend free; other students pay $35, then $45.
